name: nav-link
description: A single link used in the main-nav flyouts, footer columns, legal bar and category subcategory lists. Optional thumbnail or icon.

image.description: Optional thumbnail: 60x60 in nav flyouts (makes the flyout a thumbnail grid); in a category's subcategory list it turns the links into image chips.

view.name: NavLink
view.notes: 16px 300; hover color var(--color-primary) (fischer red / fischertechnik blue). With icon: 24px icon left, 24px gap (footer phone line). Context 'category-nav' (product-category.subcategories): without images = fischer sidebar list (14/24 600, p 12, bottom border var(--color-panel-strong), chevron right); with images = ft chip (257 wide, image 257x145 cover, label 16/600 p 24 on var(--color-panel), radio-circle glyph right as on source).
